name: Gargamelle Collaboration
notes: No formation date for the collaboration was found in the sources consulted (the Courier says only that the collaboration was spread over seven institutes in six European countries); `formation` is null and the interval below is the span of data taking.

summary.plain: The team of physicists from seven institutes in six European countries who built and used the Gargamelle bubble chamber at CERN and reported the first direct evidence of the weak neutral current.
summary.technical: Seven-institute, six-country European collaboration around the Gargamelle heavy-liquid bubble chamber; authors of Phys. Lett. B 46 (1973) 121 and 138.
